description: This file defines the PdfDocumentSettings class, which manages PDF-specific configuration such as trim margins for a PDF document within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: PdfDocumentSettings
classes.description: A class that holds PDF-specific information and settings for a document, including default trim margins.

methods.name: PdfDocumentSettings
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing an instance of PdfDocumentSettings with a given PdfDocument.

methods.name: TrimMargins get
methods.description: Accessor that returns the current TrimMargins object, initializing it if null.

methods.name: TrimMargins set
methods.description: Mutator that updates the TrimMargins object with new margin values or resets to zero if null is provided.
